name: Official-ledger rebuild (recommended)
scope: Rebuild every NFL board on one canonical 136-game official ledger with mandatory itemised injury/depth deltas and a rendered source link on every row.
includes: SUG-01, SUG-02, SUG-04, SUG-05, SUG-08, SUG-10
pros: Removes all four verified data-integrity defects; every number reconciles 32/32 to nfl.com.
cons: Largest effort; requires touching four existing subsites, which must be coordinated in COORDINATION.md.
recommendation: Adopt first. Every later path assumes a trustworthy ledger.

name: Provenance & labelling hardening
scope: Keep existing numbers but label every non-official value, retire dead citations and split the root index by domain.
pros: Small, low-risk, immediately removes the most misleading presentation defects.
cons: Does not fix the underlying stale/conflicting data.

name: Statistical rigor upgrade
scope: Re-rank the leaderboard on Deflated Sharpe Ratio with Holm-Bonferroni control, and re-price parlays/props with measured correlations and Frechet bounds.
pros: Directly answers 'remove luck, isolate selective skill'; changes which strategies get rewarded.
cons: Will demote previously top-ranked entries; historical leaderboard snapshots change retroactively.
recommendation: Adopt after PATH-A so the backtest inputs are trustworthy.

name: Process & CI enforcement
scope: Add branch-scope CI checks, snapshot-freshness checks and a link checker to the workflow.
pros: Makes the other three paths durable instead of one-off cleanups.
cons: Adds CI runtime; needs a one-time mapping of branch -> claimed scope.
recommendation: Adopt last, once the target scopes are stable.
